dog.description_text: Meet Dillion — New Arrival! Dillion just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far from his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQDhFsS7_FDIR70aM3i2NcJEAbJ0veEZBD2wZRbPXoGlkHE?e=nrfNqR Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
